facts.fact: Punch reports the Nigeria Data Protection Commission is operating under its National Commissioner and CEO, Dr Vincent Olatunji, who spoke at the 2025 Global Privacy Day event in Abuja.
Punch describes the Nigeria Data Protection Act of 2023 as law the NDPC is enforcing, with businesses required to comply.
Punch reports the NDPC, headed by National Commissioner Dr Vincent Olatunji, is regulating and investigating under the Act.
Punch says the NDPC issued in 2024 the General Application and Implementation Directive, covering 42 areas of data protection including audit filing.

Punch citing the NDPC 2024 annual report says over 36,052 data controllers and processors of major importance registered, 2,888 data protection officers were certified, and investigations rose to 213 in 2024 from 177 in 2023 and 117 in 2022.
